_comment: Emulator pins, device > OS > coin app > app version. Speculinho demands an explicit app and OS version on every run and resolves no "latest", so a run with no --os-version/--app-*-version reads its pair from here; CI and local runs therefore cannot disagree. An app appears under exactly one OS per device, which is what keeps the lookup unambiguous. A scenario needing a different pair pins it itself in the catalog, as the contacts scenarios do for the Address Book pre-release. Bump deliberately: a version has to exist on Speculinho, which trails coin-apps by up to about an hour after a release.
